# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He wears a mustache, which he continuously twirls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He displays romantic affectations, spending much of his time casting glances and courting Sukey Pullen during school hours. He can be sarcastic, overbearing, and strict when enforcing sudden discipline, though critics note that he lacks real effectiveness in maintaining order.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)_

## Traits

- Romantic  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001)</sub>
- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001)</sub>
- Ineffective disciplinarian  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching school subjects and preparing students for academy entrance exams  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>
- Reciting dramatic speeches  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Goals

- Court Sukey Pullen  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at the Brierley schoolhouse. During his tenure, he frequently neglected the younger pupils to focus on older students, particularly Sukey Pullen, whom he courted attentively during and after class. He disciplined Nell Harcourt on multiple occasions, notably assigning her to stand by the blackboard after she broke her slate over Hugh Carrow's head, and later forcing her to sit beside Hugh as a penalty for arriving late. When Nell subsequently refused to return to school for a period, local opinions on his harshness and ineffective discipline were divided. After finishing his tenure at Brierley, he delivered an emotional parting address to his students before departing the area.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P77](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0077), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- He lodged at Eben Duckett's residence while teaching in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- He secured his position as teacher partly because his uncle was a primary school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Quotes

> Nell Harcourt, what is the meaning of this?  <sub>[v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041)</sub>

> It grieves me to observe a student under my instruction showing this kind of rage and this sort of revengeful attitude  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>

> Nell Harcourt, because you appear to take such pleasure in the presence of the boys, we will satisfy your desire for it later today  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061)</sub>

> Remove those blossoms from your hair and take a seat next to Hugh Carrow.  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061)</sub>

> The time has come for us to part.  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>

- Brierley School — Teacher / Schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001)</sub>
